scope: pre-training closure and data preparation; no training, no dependency install, no model download, no Isaac environment change; all Isaac runs used a visible foreground GUI
evidence_domain: documents + configs + unit tests + offline data/annotation QA + simulated GUI capture; NOT model effect, board, navigation or gate acceptance

verdict.note: overall INCOMPLETE because A3/A4/A6/A8 are team-actionable gaps; training start is BLOCKED because A1 needs a user decision. No gate is promoted.

A1_license_decision.basis: Ultralytics AGPL-3.0 confirmed from official text; AGPL section 13 scope, weight derivative status and closed-distribution obligations remain unresolved interpretations; no user acceptance assumed; no automatic switch to the Apache-2.0 backup

A2_independent_groups.basis: dev freeze v2: 19 groups / 6 families, train 7 groups 1320 frames (1272 accepted), val 3 groups 575 frames (566 accepted), excluded 9 groups 1107 frames; 0 error for group exclusivity, consecutive-frame crossing, family crossing, duplicate sha across splits; limitation: val is only the north corridor family and static viewpoints have 3 accepted frames each -> dev selection only

A3_sealed_final_pool.basis: pool frozen: 6 new families, 297 RGB / 279 accepted in 200-400, sampling N=1 fixed rule, 0 image-sha overlap with all 3002 dev frames, 0 family/group overlap with dev freeze, GUI provenance complete; pilot annotation 34/279 frames PASS 34/34 with spec v2; missing: full semantic labels (PILOT_ONLY 34/279), no constructed full occlusion (HN2), no verified green-light similar structure (HN1 only old static_c candidate); spec v2.1 needed before full labels

A4_annotation_semantics.basis: format QA PASS 21/21 blind sample and PASS 34/34 final-pool pilot; blind proxy re-annotation n=21/33 old records: bbox IoU 0.649, keypoint 1.155 px = 0.414 deg, bearing 0.180 deg, undeterminable 19.0%, visibility 5/21 mismatch; spec v2 lead-approved for pilot; still single-agent proxy, no independent human review or adjudication, P1-P3 open before full labels

A5_version_gpu_export_evidence.basis: version pins, AGPL text, YOLOX Apache text, RKNN zoo example, RKNN-Toolkit2 proprietary license discovery, RTX 5080 sm_120 + torch 2.7.0+cu128 arch list + official cu128 win cp311 wheel, no ultralytics/onnxruntime/rknn installed; custom 1-keypoint ONNX/RKNN path explicitly UNKNOWN; official example benchmarks marked as not our results

A6_preregistration.basis: task definition, training plan v2, dev split freeze and final pool seal are recorded; the final pool full labels, threshold freeze basis and final protocol cannot be frozen until A3/A4 close and A1 is decided

A7_isolated_environment_plan.basis: isolated .venv/landmark-train plan and pins recorded; not executed because this round forbids installs; Isaac venv untouched

A8_sample_adequacy.basis: 279 accepted frames / 6 families meet the data-preparation budget, but the identity high-confidence false-match denominator is too small, no similar-structure green-light negatives exist in the final pool, and the 0.5% target cannot be certified; report INCOMPLETE rather than PASS

task_definition.class_vs_identity: class 'tower' is class evidence only; landmark_id identity requires uniqueness assumptions U1-U3, single candidate and valid reference handling
uniqueness_assumptions: U1 at most one tower-like instance in the current asset
U2 central tower is the only tower with a green roof light
U3 this experiment targets the central tower only

presence: N_neg all GT absent incl hard negatives
GT-unobservable frames excluded and reported separately

task_definition.warmup_early_stop: warmup 15 epochs with no early stop and no joint<0.60 verdict; patience 20 after warmup; diagnostic triggers are written review, not automatic abort
task_definition.seed_and_final_protocol: 3 seeds compared/selected and thresholds frozen on validation only; one final run on the sealed pool with the pre-selected scheme; no post-final callback, no rerun

final_pool.sampling_rule: N=1 all included; fallback fixed-stride rule recorded
final_pool.gui: visible foreground GUI, D3D12, RTX 5080 driver 581.80
final_pool.sealed_claim: process isolation + hash commitment only, not third-party independent

pilot_annotation.selection_rule: fixed midpoint systematic over seal accepted frames; no model/detector score, no random draw

spec_v2_1_required_before_full_labels: P1 four-edge truncation metadata in capture (near bottom cut currently missing)
P2 reference availability pixel criterion (green_pixels>=3 declared for this pilot only)
P3 clean state for TARGET_ABSENT plus visible unverified confuser

user_decisions_minimal.question: 主候选是否走 AGPL-3.0 路线（含许可未决期间内部有界训练与后续分发义务），或购买商业许可，或切换到 Apache-2.0 的 YOLOX-Nano 备选（不自动切换）？
final 池完整语义标注与模型开发是否允许同一执行者；是否投入 ≥2 名独立人工标注 + 仲裁（否则方位精度只能是代理自洽）；是否接受 hash+流程记录作为封存证据？
279 帧 final 池与 3002 帧 dev 原始包是否需要在仓库外/远端做带 hash 备份，以保证可复验性？
